decisions.statement: A property saying nothing here holds text a mechanical change respells a path in.
A property saying true here holds text no mechanical change rewrites.
A path inside such text is left as it was said, even where that path has moved.
A property whose words sit in a file of their own is read here.
Words held inside a page's own file are respelled all the same.

definition: whether a property holds words kept as they were said
